name: security-calendar-skipreview-separate
description: The block of skipReview for events and tasks (blockCalendarSkipReview) is turned off and the one for mail (blockSkipReview) keeps its default, on: createEvent and createTask with skipReview add the event and the task at once, while sendMail with skipReview and replyToMessage and forwardMessage with mode "send" are still refused before any message lookup, and nothing reaches the local SMTP sink.
